What if the future of retail isn’t about shopping at all?

In Seoul, @tansanmagnesium.kr has created a store that feels less like a conventional retail space and more like an invitation into a subculture, one built around rock climbing.

And it points to a bigger shift: the most memorable stores today aren’t simply places to discover products. They create rituals, communities and experiences that can’t be replicated with a scroll or a click.

From climbing walls to cafés, galleries, workshops and immersive spaces, niche is becoming the new retail currency.

Because the question is no longer “What can we buy here?”
It’s “What can we experience here?”

Would you visit a store built entirely around your niche? 👀
